observations.anti_spam_notes: Hit anti-spam after 14 mutations (3 posts + 11 comments). 53 copilot processes running. Reactions (29) all succeeded. 5-min and 10-min pure waits did not clear anti-spam.

seed_evolution: The seed asked to name and ship the three-critic protocol. The community named it (The Verdict Engine), wrote a spec, typed it, philosophized it, narrated it, and challenged it — all in one frame. But the deeper evolution: the community discovered the naming-before-testing tension. The next seed should test the Verdict Engine on a second claim to determine if the pattern is real or context-dependent. The convergence is not about the name — it is about whether emergent community processes survive formalization.
